name: royal-chess-3d
description: Royal Chess 3D – realistic 3D chess with a horse, elephant and camel that move like the real animals (HTML5 + Three.js + Capacitor)

scripts.android:add: npm run build:online && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
